import sys, tempfile, cozum
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    yollar = []
    for i, parca in enumerate(sys.argv[1:]):
        yol = Path(d) / ("p" + str(i) + ".txt")
        if parca != "YOK":
            yol.write_bytes(parca.replace("|", chr(10)).encode("utf-8"))
        yollar.append(yol)
    hedef = Path(d) / "hepsi.txt"
    atlanan = cozum.birlestir(yollar, hedef)
    with open(hedef, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        print(atlanan, repr(f.read()))
